name: SecretHunt
short: Retired Secret Hunt: a one-time command that unpins everything the hunt pinned.
description: The Secret Hunt is retired. This build keeps only `.secrethunt cleanup`: a dry run, then `.secrethunt cleanup confirm`, which unpins the hunt's poems and hunt objects (recorded ones, plus any forgotten ones in the rooms it used; other bot pins are never touched). Unload and uninstall it afterwards.
end_user_data_statement: This cog adds no new data. It reads what the retired Secret Hunt left behind: per member, their puzzle progress and last few button presses, and per puzzle the user IDs of solvers. All of it is deleted on a Red data-deletion request.
install_msg: Run `.secrethunt cleanup` for a dry run, then `.secrethunt cleanup confirm` to unpin. Afterwards `.unload secrethunt` and `.cog uninstall secrethunt`.
author: evacfk
